content:
Indian Navy has released the result for the Agniveer SSR & MR INET 2026 01/2027 and 02/2027 batches.

All candidates who appeared in the INET exam can check their status through the official Indian Navy Agniveer portal or candidate login.

The process includes further stages such as physical eligibility tests, medical screening and final merit-based preparation for training batches.
